turns.query: In October 2025, for the Tuen Mun station, compute the average NO2 concentration for each wind direction (using matched weather station data, only when wind speed exceeds 1 m/s to exclude calm conditions). Which wind direction is associated with the highest average NO2 and which with the lowest? Tuen Mun is located in northwestern New Territories — the highest-NO2 wind direction reveals the dominant pollution source region. Return the highest and lowest wind directions with their NO2 values, and the average NO2 when wind is from the north.
turns.actual_response:
Highest NO2 direction: NW, 56.2 µg/m³

Lowest NO2 direction: E, 23.7 µg/m³

Average NO2 from the north: 43.2 µg/m³

The dominant high-NO2 source direction for Tuen Mun in October 2025 was therefore from the northwest.

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Identify matched weather station as the nearest weather station to Tuen Mun air-quality station, then aggregate October 2025 hourly matched records.
nearest_q = text("""
SELECT ws.id AS weather_station_id, ws.name_en,
       ST_Distance(ws.coordinate, aqs.coordinate) AS distance_m
FROM weather_station ws
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON aqs.id = 5
ORDER BY ws.coordinate <-> aqs.coordinate
LIMIT 1
""")
nearest_weather = pd.read_sql(nearest_q, engine)
weather_station_id = int(nearest_weather.loc[0, "weather_station_id"])
weather_station_name = nearest_weather.loc[0, "name_en"]
weather_station_distance_m = float(nearest_weather.loc[0, "distance_m"])

count_q = text("""
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
FROM hourly_station_air_quality aq
JOIN hourly_station_weather w ON w.datetime = aq.datetime
WHERE aq.station_id = 5
  AND w.station_id = :wsid
  AND aq.datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND aq.datetime <  TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND aq.no2 IS NOT NULL
  AND w.wind_direction IS NOT NULL
  AND w.wind_speed > 1
""")
match_count = int(pd.read_sql(count_q, engine, params={"wsid": weather_station_id}).loc[0, "n"])

agg_q = text("""
SELECT w.wind_direction::text AS direction,
       COUNT(*) AS hours,
       AVG(aq.no2) AS avg_no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality aq
JOIN hourly_station_weather w ON w.datetime = aq.datetime
WHERE aq.station_id = 5
  AND w.station_id = :wsid
  AND aq.datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND aq.datetime <  TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND aq.no2 IS NOT NULL
  AND w.wind_direction IS NOT NULL
  AND w.wind_speed > 1
GROUP BY w.wind_direction
ORDER BY avg_no2 DESC
""")
rose = pd.read_sql(agg_q, engine, params={"wsid": weather_station_id})

if rose.empty:
    raise ValueError("No matched October 2025 records with wind speed > 1 m/s and valid NO2/wind direction.")

high = rose.loc[rose["avg_no2"].idxmax()]
low = rose.loc[rose["avg_no2"].idxmin()]
north_rows = rose[rose["direction"] == "N"]
if north_rows.empty:
    raise ValueError("No valid north-wind records after filtering.")

highest_no2_direction = str(high["direction"])
highest_no2_value = round(float(high["avg_no2"]), 1)
lowest_no2_direction = str(low["direction"])
lowest_no2_value = round(float(low["avg_no2"]), 1)
north_sector_no2 = round(float(north_rows.iloc[0]["avg_no2"]), 1)

print({
    "matched_weather_station": weather_station_name,
    "weather_station_distance_m": round(weather_station_distance_m, 0),
    "matched_hours_after_filter": match_count,
    "direction_count": int(len(rose)),
    "highest_no2_direction": highest_no2_direction,
    "highest_no2_value": highest_no2_value,
    "lowest_no2_direction": lowest_no2_direction,
    "lowest_no2_value": lowest_no2_value,
    "north_sector_no2": north_sector_no2
})
print(rose.assign(avg_no2=rose["avg_no2"].round(1)).to_string(index=False))
